title: Object Storage: archive minimum days
content:
Object Storage archive minimum days is defined as follows: Minimum retention for archive objects; calendar days integer.

| Contract tier | Archive minimum days |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | archive minimum days: 90 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | archive minimum days: 90 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | archive minimum days: 90 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | archive minimum days: 90 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | archive minimum days: 90 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | archive minimum days: 90 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the archive minimum days entry is 90.
